test.title: Telling a friend about a new choir

document.lead: You should spend about 20 minutes on this task.
after: You do NOT need to write any addresses.

text: Sorry I haven’t written for a while – life has been really busy! But I’ve got some exciting news: I’ve joined a community choir.

It’s a friendly group of about forty people of all ages, and we meet every Thursday evening in the old library on Hill Street. We sing all kinds of music, from pop songs to traditional folk songs, and in December we’re giving a concert in the town hall.

You know I’ve always loved singing in the car, but I was too shy to sing in front of anyone. After I moved here, I didn’t know many people, so when a colleague told me about the choir, I thought it would be a good way to meet people and build my confidence. It’s been even better than I expected.

Why don’t you come along one Thursday when you visit next month? Nobody has to audition, and new people are always welcome. We usually go to a café afterwards, so you could meet some of my new friends too.
Let me know what you think, and say hello to your family from me.

note.en: Moves from the apology to the news.
A contrast: she loved singing but was shy.
note.kk: Қарама-қайшылық: ән айтқанды жақсы көрді, бірақ ұялды.

note.en: Sets the time in the story.
A consequence: few friends, so she decided to join.
A benefit for the friend: meeting new people.
note.ru: Выгода для подруги: познакомиться с друзьями.

strengths.en: The reason for joining is told as a story, which is more interesting and natural.
strengths.kk: Қосылу себебі оқиға ретінде айтылған — бұл қызықтырақ әрі табиғи.
strengths.ru: Причина вступления рассказана как история — это интереснее и естественнее.
strengths.example: I was too shy to sing in front of anyone

strengths.en: When to come and why there is nothing to worry about: “Nobody has to audition”.
strengths.kk: Қашан келу керек және неге қорықпау керек: «Nobody has to audition».
strengths.ru: Когда прийти и почему не страшно: «Nobody has to audition».

strengths.en: Contractions, dashes and exclamations, but accurate grammar.
strengths.kk: Қысқартулар, сызықша, лепті сөйлемдер — бірақ грамматика дәл.
strengths.ru: Сокращения, тире, восклицания — но грамматика точная.

strengths.en: “I’ve joined” and “It’s been even better” describe recent events with a present result.
strengths.kk: «I’ve joined», «It’s been even better» — нәтижесі қазір бар жақында болған оқиғалар.
strengths.ru: «I’ve joined», «It’s been even better» — недавние события с результатом сейчас.
strengths.example: It’s been even better than I expected.

note.en: A friend, by first name: informal.
An apology for not writing — a natural start to a friendly letter — and the main news.
note.kk: Ұзақ жазбағаны үшін кешірім — досқа хаттың табиғи басталуы — және басты жаңалық.
note.ru: Извинение за молчание — естественное начало письма другу — и главная новость.

note.en: Bullet 1: what the group is — who, where, when, what they sing.
note.kk: 1-тармақ — қандай топ: кім, қай жерде, қашан, не айтады.
note.ru: Пункт 1 — что за группа: кто, где, когда, что поют.

note.en: Bullet 2: why she joined — a personal story, not a list of reasons.
note.kk: 2-тармақ — неге қосылды: себептер тізімі емес, жеке оқиға.
note.ru: Пункт 2 — почему вступила: личная история, а не список причин.

note.en: Bullet 3: the invitation and what will put the friend at ease.
note.kk: 3-тармақ — шақыру және құрбысының күмәнін сейілтетін нәрсе.
note.ru: Пункт 3 — приглашение и то, что снимет сомнения подруги.

note.en: A request for a reply and greetings to the family.
note.kk: Жауап беруді сұрау және отбасына сәлем.

note.en: “Lots of love” suits a close friend.

document.title: Telling a friend about a new choir
bullets: tell your friend about the group you have joined
explain why you decided to join
invite your friend to come to one of the meetings
document.question:
